Lesson: Context Engineering. Objective: select and organize minimum authorized context. Canonical example: tutor needs approved lesson and learner's own attempt, not other learners' work or a hidden answer key. Dominant metaphor: a precision translucent selection aperture gathering just two relevant unmarked paper fragments into a neat focused bundle; other fragments remain outside the aperture. Secondary element: a quiet layered reference sheet. Show information selection and boundary, not a padlock. No assessment answers.
